LanguageData.CC_Good_Band_Steady_Desc: Nothing to speak of either way yet. Good days fill the heart's good side while strain is at nothing.
LanguageData.CC_Good_Band_GoodHeart_Desc: The good days have added up: +2 mood, brighter dreams, and they get over hard times sooner. A hard knock spends some of it before any strain builds.
LanguageData.CC_Good_Band_HighSpirits_Desc: +3 mood, brighter dreams still, a quicker recovery from strain, and now and then something good comes of it: an inspiration, or a kind word for someone close.
LanguageData.CC_Good_Source_Deeds: a deed the colony speaks well of
LanguageData.CC_Good_NothingBuilt: Nothing has filled the good side lately.
LanguageData.CC_Good_Explain: The heart's good side is the other side of strain, and never both at once. It fills slowly while strain is at nothing, mostly from what can't be bought: friends close by, a purpose, deeds the colony speaks well of, gatherings, good talks and a run of small joys; the comforts of home only a little (4 a day at most in all). A hard knock spends it, half a point for each point of strain it would have built, before any strain builds, and it fades slowly. In good heart from 45 (+2 mood), in high spirits from 65 (+3 mood), with brighter dreams and a quicker recovery from strain.
LanguageData.CC_Good_InStrainTip: The other side of the heart: {BAND} ({VALUE}). It grows beside strain, slower the more there is; a hard knock spends part of it as a cushion, and good things ease strain and fill it together.
LanguageData.CC_Good_ColonySummary: {GOOD} in good heart, {HIGH} in high spirits.
LanguageData.CC_Good_InspiredReason: {PAWN_nameDef} has been in high spirits for a good while.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_HeartGoodSide: The heart's good side: in good heart, in high spirits
LanguageData.CC_Settings_HeartGoodSide_Tip: The other side of strain, growing beside it: someone can be worn down by a hard spell and still in good heart. Good days that keep coming fill it slowly, slower the more strain there is: friends close by, a purpose, deeds the colony speaks well of, gatherings, good talks and small joys, the comforts of home only a little. A hard knock spends part of it as a cushion and builds less strain, and it fades slowly. Steady, in good heart and in high spirits a colonist has a small good mood (+2, +3 and +5); in good heart and in high spirits also brighter dreams and a quicker recovery from strain, and in high spirits, now and then, an inspiration or a kind word for someone close. Turned off, nothing fills it and the bands give nothing; strain works as it always has.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HeartGoodSide: Good days that keep coming fill the heart's other side: a small good mood, brighter dreams, now and then an inspiration.
